systems.system: Pilot operation issuing birth certificates, identity cards and NIU to vulnerable households
systems.country_label: opération pilote de délivrance d'actes de naissance, de CNI et de NIU
systems.owner: Ministère des Affaires sociales, de la Solidarité et de l'Action humanitaire, through the PSIPJ project with World Bank support
systems.tiers: Talangaï town hall, Brazzaville's sixth arrondissement, from 15 January 2026: 6,338 documents, of which 2,381 birth certificates, 1,743 identity cards and 2,214 NIU; extension to other localities envisaged if the pilot succeeds

systems.owner: Ministère des Affaires sociales, de la Solidarité et de l'Action humanitaire
systems.tiers: national digital database of vulnerable households; no class of the typology fits it

note: A one-off, project-financed drive handing out documents at one town hall: outreach, not an office registering digitally. The article does not say how the birth certificates were made.
